description: Hypothesis: reduce prefill dispatches and intermediate memory traffic using resident FP16 operands for small projections, grouped Q/K/V and GDN a/b and shared gate/up projections, shared-expert activation plus FP16 packing, and fused attention preparation. Independently test affine decode inside dense matmul; retain this regressing prototype only as an opt-in diagnostic. Selected dispatch mask 29 preserves existing FP16 operands/KV, FP32 state/accumulation and reduction order. Grow dense scratch by 4 MiB, retain approximately 7.6 MiB of small weights and reuse dead expert activation storage. Target affine-8 group-64 v2, BF16 draft, staged8, 2048-token chunks, 32768-token context, prefix semantics and evaluator remain unchanged. Run all seven Full-profile tests. Launch-count reductions do not imply proportional wall-time gains.
